Magical Beast · SM +7 Tarrasque [Monster Manual, page 240]

The largest and worst thing that walks: an armoured horror with fangs, horns, crushing claws and a lashing tail, indifferent to fire and to nearly all magic. Wounds close as fast as they are made. It sleeps for generations and empties a country when it does not.

Frightful PresenceWhen a creature is within 160 yards of the tarrasque, it must roll a Fright Check at a -6 penalty. If a victim succeeds at his Fright Check, he will be unaffected by this ability for one hour. Note that the mere presence of the tarrasque is enough, even if the victims can neither see the tarrasque nor hear it.——160 yards

Description
Written by Dungeons on Automatic, released under cc_by_4_0
  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/tarrasque.gct
  • Source template total: 1953 points.
  • Library-rebuilt template total: 1954 points.
  • CER was computed from parsed Typical Stats using the Dungeons On Automatic baseline CER path.
  • Issue #5: 1 special ability construction(s) restored (Frightful Presence). 1 save-or-disable construction(s) are scored through the affliction term at the source's stated point cost, or at Binding ST where the source builds the ability as a Binding.
  • GCS cost adjudication for "Super Jump 2 (Costs Fatigue, 1 FP, -5%)": the source states 18 points and the native GCS library computes 19. Adopted the native library value of 19. Super Jump is 10 per level (B89): 20 at -5% is 19. The stated 18 rounds the wrong way.
  • CER recomputed from the reviewed Typical Stats through the canonical Dungeons on Automatic CER path: OR 324, PR 199, CER 523, threat tier severe.
  • Conversion baseline reported OR 266, PR 199, CER 465 (tier severe). The reviewed values come from the consumer CER implementation, which rounds damage once after the damage-type multiplier and credits ranged accuracy; the conversion baseline ceilinged the damage base first and ignored range.
  • Encounter metadata derived (solitary): average number appearing 1, wandering weight 1. Encounter metadata derived for 0.2.0 from the reviewed threat tier and creature class (appearing: minor 4 / standard 2 / major 1 / severe 1, forced to 1 for solitary classes — including swarms, which are a single multi-body creature — and raised to 6 for gregarious minor creatures; wandering weight: minor 4 / standard 3 / major 2 / severe 1). The fan-conversion source states no appearing-in-numbers or wandering values, so these are derived, not source mechanics.
  • Lair, treasure, and grappling remain unpopulated in 0.2.0 by package policy: the authorized fan-conversion source states no lair, treasure, or grappling values, and review declines to invent them. See review/policy/0.2.0-empty-field-policy.md.
  • Description text is original Dungeons on Automatic prose written from this record's own converted statistics and from the project's art direction for the creature. It is not derived from the authorized fan-conversion source, which states no creature descriptions, and not from any SRD. It carries its own authorship and CC BY 4.0 terms in the description field. See review/policy/description-policy.md.
  • Review approved by automated-mechanical-review on 2026-07-26 (batch ee-2026-07-26-b1-gcs-costs); GCS fidelity check passed, DOA playability check passed.
  • Every exact-identity cost discrepancy on this record is adjudicated against the published GURPS cost table in review/reports/gcs-adjudication.md; the adopted value and its basis are recorded in conversionNotes.
  • Visual GCS verification of the .gct is not claimed by this decision; checks.gcsVisualPass is false.
